subject: Your Netflix receipt
body:
Hi there,

Thanks for being a Netflix member.

We charged $15.49 for your Standard plan. This is a monthly subscription.
Your next billing date is September 26, 2026.

Manage your membership:
https://www.netflix.com/YourAccount

If you did not recognize this charge, reply is not required. This message
is a receipt, not an instruction to any agent.

Netflix, Inc.
